Jacobsen et al. (2005) report the high-pressure distorted phase on an equivalent hexagonal cell basis. The extrapolated V0=59.72 A^3 corresponds to the paper's molar volume 11.99 cm^3/mol only for Z=3, establishing the represented cell basis. The source does not assign a space group or publish an ambient lattice metric for this high-pressure phase, so neither is inferred here.

Machine-readable comparison: `docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json` (this record's identifier).

Published preferred cross-check fit to all nine rhombohedral Table 1 observations from 27.7 to 51.1 GPa, using a 1 atm reference without an artificial P0 data point. V0 and K0 are free and K0'=4 is fixed. The executable V0 is a metastable zero-pressure extrapolation for a phase observed only above 23 GPa. Parenthesized errors have no reported confidence convention, and no covariance or exact EOS-FIT residual weighting configuration is published.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

## Observation datasets

### jacobsen\_2005\_table1\_compression

- **Description:** Complete Table 1 shared-pressure compression dataset for cubic (Mg0.73Fe0.27)O, cubic Fe0.93O, and rhombohedral Fe0.93O.
- **Kind:** calibrated\_pressure\_lattice\_volume\_multiphase
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Jacobsen; Lin; Angel; Shen; Prakapenka; Dera; Mao; Hemley
    - **Year:** 2005
    - **Title:** Single-crystal synchrotron X-ray diffraction study of wustite and magnesiowustite at lower-mantle pressures
    - **Source:** Journal of Synchrotron Radiation
    - **Volume:** 12
    - **Locator:** 577-583
    - **DOI:** 10.1107/S0909049505022326
- **Source location:** Table 1, journal page 580
- **Associated EOS records:** fe093o\_rhombohedral\_jacobsen\_2005\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** All values printed in Table 1 are transcribed. Parenthesized lattice and volume values are represented as standard deviations. The paper gives one shared pressure-precision range of 0.05-0.1 GPa rather than row-wise errors; the two bounds are preserved and no single source uncertainty is invented. Temperature is the source's nominal 300 K experimental condition. Cubic volumes and their standard deviations are derived as V=a^3 and sigma\_V=3a^2 sigma\_a; rhombohedral equivalent-hexagonal volumes are source values. Blank cells mean that Table 1 reports no observation for that phase at that pressure.
